name: Sushi Go!

rounds.endCondition: 3 rounds, then puddings are scored once

categories.label: Points from each round
categories.hint: Per round: maki most 6 / 2nd 3 (ties split, round down); tempura pair 5; sashimi set of 3 = 10; dumplings 1/3/6/10/15; nigiri squid 3, salmon 2, egg 1 (x3 on wasabi).

categories.label: Pudding cards kept (all 3 rounds)
categories.hint: Most puddings +6, fewest -6 (ties split, round down toward zero). 2 players: no penalty for fewest.

tiebreakers.description: Most pudding cards wins the tie

notes: family: set-collection-rounds. Round scores are entered as totals per round (maki race, tempura, sashimi, dumpling, nigiri/wasabi not itemised). Pudding scoring is one rank award [6, 0.., -6] so a tie for most or fewest splits correctly and an all-equal table nets 0. Rare edge: a 4-way tie for fewest in a 5-player game gives -2 here, rulebook says remainder is ignored (-1). Two-player dummy-hand variant and pass-both-ways variant do not change scoring.
